taxonomicConcept: Total-seed-plant navigation surrogate for the Gymnospermae package root
geographicScope: Famennian Hampshire Formation seed sample to living gymnosperm families

uncertainty.note: The Famennian endpoint is a rounded total-seed-plant sample and is not a crown age or FAD for living Gymnospermae.

evidenceBasis: Cupulate lagenostomalean-type seeds anchor the extinct total-group record; complete living-family sampling contextualizes the present endpoint.

geographicScope: Fossilized birth–death model estimate for crown Cycadales plus living cycads

uncertainty.note: The 330.4 Ma older endpoint is a fossilized birth–death posterior median with 95% HPD 296.2–358.9 Ma, not a directly observed fossil FAD.

evidenceBasis: Coiro et al. integrate 60 fossil species with living cycads and estimate crown Cycadales at median 330.4 Ma; 0 Ma denotes living members.

uncertainty.note: The 165 Ma edge is the older limit of a 153–165 Ma fossil-wood sample, not a ginkgophyte phylum FAD or a continuous single lineage.

evidenceBasis: Jiang et al. date and diagnose Ginkgoxylon liaoningense from the 153–165 Ma Tiaojishan Formation; 0 Ma denotes living Ginkgo.

evidenceBasis: Leslie et al. review an extensive conifer fossil record spanning more than 300 Myr and explicitly caution that extant molecular samples omit extinct diversity.
